forbidden_red_lines.claim: Never render the literal string 'TheIWise' or 'theiwise' or 'theiwise.com' in any public-domain response body.
forbidden_red_lines.reason: Hard RED LINE per session-4 spec PART 12 + docs/no-touch-red-line.md — visible brand strings come only from per-site CMS data, never hardcoded.

forbidden_red_lines.claim: Never include the substring 'cms.kodigital.app' in any response body served from a public content domain.
forbidden_red_lines.reason: Tenant boundary rule: the CMS admin host MUST NOT leak from public content domains. Already enforced by publicSiteContextMiddleware; this contract forbids reintroducing leakage via template strings.

forbidden_red_lines.claim: Never use href="#" in rendered Home or Article output.
forbidden_red_lines.reason: PART 8 forbids placeholder anchors. Disabled state must be expressed via aria-disabled + button element or accessible explanation, never a no-op href.

accessibility_constraints: no nested interactive controls inside card links
alt text + width + height on every
newsletter input has label even if visually hidden

content_blocks.text_or_ref: Hero section pulls site.tagline + site.site_name + hero search; image uses fetchpriority=high.
Up to 3 featured articles, first card enlarged by CSS; URLs use /article/:slug.
Up to 5 trending stories; pulse-dot marker; horizontal scroller below 980px.
Newsletter input + button. Disabled with accessible state when no provider configured; POSTs to placeholder endpoint when provider key present.
FAQ section rendered only when faqs[] non-empty; emits FAQPage JSON-LD on same condition.
Share rail + bottom share buttons. Use navigator.share with clipboard fallback; accessible disabled state otherwise.
